representations.name: Greedy full-orbit replay
representations.new_information: Retains the unique Macaulay word at every rank instead of a sign or tail summary.
representations.first_test: Replay actual K4,r9 odd strips and compare the first nonnegative rank with the stable word.

representations.name: Rank-two wall coordinates (t,s,R)
representations.new_information: Records a literal bottom-top shift s and residual R across a canonical wall.
representations.first_test: Check C(t,2)+B=C(t+s,2)+R and every strict digit inequality.

representations.name: Pascal transfer ledger
representations.new_information: Derives the q-slope of the new residual from the exact before/after identity.
representations.first_test: Expand R for s=0,1,2,3 and read alpha from its q coefficient.

representations.name: Canonical wall simplex
representations.new_information: Partitions B_m by consecutive triangular increments and exposes the maximum shift before collision with the preceding rank-three top.
representations.first_test: Prove the exact half-open intervals for s=0,1,2,3 and test s=4 legality.

representations.name: Round-six affine-coordinate pullback
representations.new_information: Maps a real word shift back to alpha,delta rather than assigning them abstractly.
representations.first_test: Verify that s=3 gives alpha=3,delta=0 in the inherited sign convention.

representations.name: Actual odd-j wall lattice
representations.new_information: Keeps q_(j+2)=4q_j-4 and locates which actual member lies immediately below each fixed B_m wall.
representations.first_test: For each tested rank, compute the unique odd j with q_j<=B_m<q_(j+2).

representations.name: Surplus-before/after certificate
representations.new_information: Retains both the negative pre-switch surplus and positive post-switch surplus on the identical actual member.
representations.first_test: Directly evaluate gamma_11 and gamma_12 from greedy upper shadows.

representations.name: Uniqueness obstruction
representations.new_information: Separates a true canonical cell change from a fictitious alternative expansion of one integer.
representations.first_test: Demand equality of values and strict greedy ordering; reject any second canonical word.

representations.name: Switched-seed suffix interface
representations.new_information: Tracks whether a recovered local surplus is identified with the public diagonal capacity and persists to rank 42.
representations.first_test: Require an explicit mapping and suffix theorem rather than assuming positivity is automatically composable.
